We need to count carbonyl groups in the molecule. But we have no description of the molecule. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve IR spectra to see C=O stretch? Or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbon shifts (~190-220 ppm). But we need the molecule structure. No SMILES given. Maybe the sample is implicit? Could be the "sample at hand" refers to some default compound? We need to get IR spectra to detect carbonyl peaks. Use ir_spectra tool. That will give IR peaks; we can count C=O peaks (~1700 cm-1). However carbonyl groups could be multiple. IR may show multiple peaks if different types. But we can also get carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons. Use carbon_nmr_spectra. That will list chemical shifts; carbonyl carbons appear ~190-220 ppm. Count them.

We should use minimal tools. Probably just get carbon NMR. Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
